author: RITIK GUPTA
body:
Expedia Group — SDE Internship Experience

I got selected for the SDE Intern role at Expedia Group through the campus placement process at NIT Jalandhar. The selection process focused mainly on DSA, problem-solving, CS fundamentals, and projects.

I prepared by regularly practicing DSA on LeetCode, revising subjects like OOP, DBMS, OS and Computer Networks, and making sure I could confidently explain everything on my resume.

The interviews included coding problems, project discussions, and technical questions. One thing I learned was that explaining your approach and thought process is just as important as getting the correct answer.

After clearing the process, I completed a 2-month SDE internship in Gurgaon during June–July. The experience gave me valuable exposure to working in a professional software-development environment.

My biggest advice would be to focus on strong fundamentals, practice DSA consistently, and know your projects inside out.

title: Expedia Group On-Campus Internship & PPO
author: PRABHNOOR SINGH
body:
On-Campus Internship Opportunity (August 2025)

The process kicked off when Expedia Group visited our campus for internship hiring. The initial screening consisted of two online assessment rounds:

• Capfinity Behavioral Assessment: Evaluated behavioral traits, workplace situations, and alignment with Expedia's core values.

• Technical Online Assessment (OA):

• 2 Coding Questions: Focused on Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA).

• 5–6 MCQs: Covered core Computer Science fundamentals (DBMS, OS, OOPs, Computer Networks).

On-Campus Offline Interviews

After shortlisting from the online assessment, candidates were called for face-to-face interviews.

• Format: Back-to-back 2 Technical & Behavioral Rounds with two different interviewers.

• Coding & DSA Setup:

• 2 DSA Questions per Round (4 questions in total).

• Paper-and-pen format: Explain the approach, perform a dry run on sample inputs, and write clean pseudocode.

• Behavioral Discussion: Both rounds included questions evaluating problem-solving mindset, teamwork, and past project experience.

The Summer Internship (June – July 2026)

• Duration: 2 Months

• Location: Offsite at the Expedia Group Gurgaon Office

The final Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) evaluation was based on:

1. Overall project execution and impact during the 2 months.

2. Performance review and rating by the Manager.

3. Organizational requirements and team alignment.

title: My Expedia Summer Internship to PPO Journey
author: DHRUV SINGLA
body:
My journey with Expedia started last year when I got shortlisted for their Online Assessment. The first step was a behavioral assessment, and after clearing that, I appeared for the OA that included two DSA coding questions. I cleared the assessment and was shortlisted for the interview rounds.

There were two technical interview rounds, each focused on problem-solving and core CS concepts. After performing well in the interviews, I received the opportunity to join Expedia as a Summer Intern at their Gurgaon office.

I was assigned to the DEVEX (Developer Experience) team, where I worked on real-world engineering problems and contributed to impactful projects. My internship experience was extremely enriching, and based on my performance, I was grateful to receive a Full-Time Employment (PPO) offer from Expedia.
